hooks.command: if [ -n "${STEERING_FORGEBIN:-}" ] && [ -n "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-}" ]; then q=$(printf %s "$STEERING_FORGEBIN" | sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g"); printf "export PATH='%s':\"\$PATH\"\n" "$q" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; fi; exit 0
if [ -z "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then exit 0; fi; exec python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/steering/enroll/codex_observe.py"
for R in "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do if [ -n "$R" ] && [ -f "$R/steering/enroll/delete_guard.py" ]; then exec python3 "$R/steering/enroll/delete_guard.py"; fi; done; exit 0
